title: Book "Zhangjiajie" Wrong and You'll Miss the Avatar Pillars | China Travel Expert
description:
Book a "Zhangjiajie" trip without checking and you can miss the Avatar pillars entirely — because "Zhangjiajie" is really two separate parks.

The quartz-sandstone pillars that inspired Avatar are in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, out in Wulingyuan, roughly 30 km from the city — the tallest columns top 400 m, and you want two to three days there. Tianmen Mountain, with the glass skywalk, the long cable car and the 99-bend road, is a different mountain near the city centre. The two have separate tickets (Tianmen about ¥288; the Forest Park pass runs about ¥228–298 for multiple days) and nothing you buy for one gets you into the other.

🧭 Expert Tip: If you came for the Avatar peaks, book Zhangjiajie National Forest Park / Wulingyuan — not Tianmen Mountain. Tour listings blur the two.
